flags.message: record/documents/lower-court-docket.txt reports 'dissent noted: not found' for the Second Circuit's March 19, 2026 order denying rehearing en banc (entry 315 on docket 67110483), whereas five active Second Circuit judges filed two published dissents from the denial of rehearing en banc (170 F.4th 100; CourtListener opinion_id=11277807). Also, decision-below.txt was not staged despite both 152 F.4th 339 and 170 F.4th 100 being available on CourtListener.

record/documents/documents.json was last fetched on 2026-11-09, before the Court's 2026-11-16 order granting leave to file Petitioners' October 30, 2026 supplemental brief, so supplemental-brief.txt was not yet staged on disk (retrieved directly from the snapshot's DocketPDF URL in forward mode).
